title: SCAFFOLD-DIST-001: site the AGENTS.md scaffolder, pin its self-test in core_ci
intent: Distribute the AGENTS.md scaffolder as tooling: site scripts/scaffold_agents_md.py, add its self-test at scripts/ci/test_scaffold_agents_md.py, pin that test in core_ci.yml so the contract is enforced rather than asserted, and record the defect-by-defect result. This is a TOOLING DISTRIBUTION change only — it does NOT adopt an AGENTS.md in this repository. No AGENTS.md is written, and none is expected to appear in the diff; adoption is a separate owner decision under a separate rollout.
behavior_change: none at runtime; adds one CI test invocation

diff_articulation.what_changed: Transported as an ordered four-patch git format-patch series (D2 order preserved via git am, not flattened into one diff): (1) scripts/ci/test_scaffold_agents_md.py — 14-case self-test covering remote-derived repo naming, PR-template discovery in any casing across .github/ root and docs/, headless --force refusal, headless --force --yes overwrite, refusal on an undetectable default branch, --default-branch override, the happy path with TODO blocks left unfilled, non-clobber on a second run, and refusal of a non-git directory. (2) .github/workflows/core_ci.yml — pins that test so the contract is enforced by CI rather than by assertion. (3) scripts/scaffold_agents_md.py — the scaffolder itself, brought under the test contract. (4) reports/scaffold/scaffold_dist_001/RESULT.md — defect-by-defect record. (5) this per-PR CBSP21 manifest, added as commit 5.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Neither scripts/scaffold_agents_md.py nor scripts/ci/test_scaffold_agents_md.py exists on main at the pinned base c9c60779 — both re-derived ABSENT via git ls-tree, not by a ref:path check (which silently mangles under MSYS and produced a false negative on first pass). core_ci.yml line 50 carries only the governance pytest pin; the scaffolder test is a new invocation, not a duplicate. The scaffolder's four fixed defects were all environment-coupling bugs invisible to reading and found only by execution, which is precisely why the self-test is pinned in CI rather than left as a one-time manual witness.
